baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at 96:10[1] is temporally exposed through the prayer verb at 96:10[3].
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive worship names the person's relation, while binding ritual prayer gives that relation an embodied event; servanthood becomes visible precisely when it is enacted.

activation_trace.role: Worship and submissive obedience make the noun an enacted devotional identity.
Binding ritual prayer supplies the concrete act and bodily postures that manifest that identity.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified servant happens to pray.
changed_reading.after: A person's servanthood comes into view at the moment it is bodily enacted as binding worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The indefinite عَبْدًا at 96:10[1] can retain social owned-status while صَلَّى at 96:10[3] marks worship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase overlays external social possession and an interiorly directed ritual act. The same person can be socially ownable yet act within a devotional relation not exhausted by that status.

activation_trace.role: Slavery and owned status preserve the vulnerable social sense of the noun.
Prescribed worship gives the socially dependent person an action with its own normative order.

changed_reading.before: Servant is only a devotional title.
changed_reading.after: The praying figure can also be a socially vulnerable, ownable person whose worship exceeds the relation imposed on him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The worshipper noun at 96:10[1] is joined to a prayer root at 96:10[3] whose inventory includes supplication, praise, and mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prayer is relational traffic rather than posture alone: submissive address moves outward as plea or praise and opens toward blessing, mercy, or purification.

activation_trace.role: Devotional submission supplies the speaking relation of the worshipper.
Supplication, praise, and mercy make prayer a bidirectional relation rather than a bare motion.

changed_reading.before: The servant performs a bounded ritual.
changed_reading.after: The servant enters an address in which plea and praise move toward another and mercy can move back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation and originating attachment establish dependence; imagined self-sufficiency breaks its recognition; return and final approach restore its direction. Prayer becomes a recurrent reattachment of the created servant rather than an isolated pious episode.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship anchors the model in the servant's chosen dependence.
Binding prayer supplies the recurrent embodied act of reattachment.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply an originating relation that sustains the servant.
Creative bringing-into-being makes dependence prior to the servant's action.
Attachment and clinging provide the material image for original dependence.
Self-sufficiency supplies the counter-state that forgets attachment.
Return restores direction toward the relation from which autonomy had turned.
Nearness gives the restored dependence a spatial outcome.

structural_cues: Creation and attachment precede the focus, while return and the final imperative of approach bracket it from the far side.
The self-sufficiency claim intervenes between origin and return, making prayer a possible counter-movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, attachment, self-sufficiency, return, and nearness; I infer the arrow prayer-as-reattachment. A live alternative is that prayer merely evidences dependence rather than causing its renewed recognition.

changed_reading.before: A servant performs a discrete prayer.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is the created dependent's repeated return from imagined sufficiency into attachment and nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lordship, transgressive prohibition, command, turning away, negated obedience, prostration, and approach form a contest over who may direct the servant. عبد no longer marks generic lowliness: it becomes selective allegiance enacted through prayer and refusal of a rival command.

activation_trace.role: Submissive obedience, including the inventory's possibility of misdirected obedience, makes allegiance the focus issue.
Binding prayer is the concrete act through which allegiance is declared.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty establish one legitimate claim over the servant.
Crossing the limit in disobedience characterizes the rival claim as an overreach.
Prohibition and restraint supply the rival's attempted control of the prayer act.
Demand and obligation make command itself an explicit axis of comparison.
Turning away supplies the directional refusal opposed to devotional approach.
Obedience is explicitly negated toward the prohibitor, separating submission from indiscriminate compliance.
Voluntary abasement supplies the positive bodily form of the servant's chosen allegiance.
Approach gives chosen submission a destination opposite to turning away.

structural_cues: The prohibition in 96:9 opens directly onto the focus phrase in 96:10.
The final sequence negates obedience to one agent and immediately commands prostration and approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two command fields and opposite bodily directions; I infer that prayer adjudicates rival claims to obedience. A live alternative is a simpler moral contrast without a broader sovereignty mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The phrase identifies a generally submissive worshipper.
changed_reading.after: The worshipper selects an allegiance: prayer refuses a transgressive command while enacting servitude toward the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act is followed by two conditional tracks: being upon guidance or commanding protection, versus denying and turning away. Prayer becomes the hinge of an inquiry whose agent assignments and moral diagnosis must be inferred rather than a label that automatically settles them.

activation_trace.role: Devotional obedience supplies the candidate identity being tested by the surrounding alternatives.
Prescribed worship supplies the observable act around which the diagnosis branches.
The attention-seeking interrogative keeps the reader evaluating rather than merely receiving a settled report.
Occurrence and presence in a state supply the conditional possibility of being upon guidance.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the first live moral track.
Command and obligation extend the first track from private state to directed action.
Putting oneself in protection gives the commanded piety a protective mechanism.
Contradiction of truth supplies the opposed diagnostic track.
Turning away gives the opposed track its bodily direction.

structural_cues: The paired conditionals of 96:11-13 follow the focus without restating their pronoun referents.
Guidance and protective command coexist as one track; denial and turning away coexist as its rival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional grammar and opposed branch images; I infer that the focus is an abductive test rather than self-interpreting proof. A live alternative assigns every pronoun consistently to one known actor and reduces the branching ambiguity.

changed_reading.before: Praying by itself fixes the servant's role and the scene's moral agents.
changed_reading.after: The prayer is evidence inside a two-track diagnosis; guidance, protective command, denial, and withdrawal keep more than one agent reading live.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading, a visible naming-mark, teaching as a distinguishing sign, and the writing reed establish a semiotic field before the focus; seeing and the bodily trace of prostration continue it afterward. Prayer can therefore be read as knowledge written by the servant's body and made publicly legible.

activation_trace.role: Devotional service supplies the identity that the bodily sign expresses.
Ritual postures turn the servant's relation into a bodily sequence capable of bearing a sign.
Reading and recitation open the context as reception and performance of signs.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible identifying mark makes naming materially legible.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the bridge from teaching to visible orientation.
The sharpened writing reed supplies the explicit inscription instrument.
Sight and insight make the embodied inscription answerable to a witness.
The organs and trace of prostration make worship leave a bodily mark.

structural_cues: Reading, naming, teaching, and pen form a sequence before the focus; repeated seeing and a final prostration form a visibility sequence after it.
The prayer verb interrupts the prose as a bodily act between verbal inscription and witnessed bodily trace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, writing, seeing, ritual posture, and prostration's trace; I infer a shared inscription mechanism with the body as medium. A live alternative keeps literacy and ritual as adjacent but independent domains.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is an action observed in the narrative.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is embodied writing: the servant's learned allegiance becomes a visible mark that human and divine observers can read differently.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflowing force and prohibition lead to threatened forelock seizure and pushing, while prayer leads to commanded bowing and nearness. The context separates voluntary self-lowering from externally imposed subjugation and gives the two motions opposite outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Physical subduing and smoothing provide a material analogy for a body made yielding.
Ritual prayer supplies voluntary postural discipline rather than imposed collapse.
Rising water and sweeping force supply the upward, boundary-breaking counter-motion.
Restraint supplies the first attempt to arrest the servant's chosen motion.
Seizing by the forelock turns control into threatened bodily force.
The forelock as a grasping point localizes imposed control at the body's leading edge.
Pushing, collision, and prevention extend the coercive motion.
Bowing the head supplies a chosen downward motion that answers threatened forelock seizure.
Nearness is the result of voluntary lowering rather than coercive capture.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from overflow and prohibition to forelock seizure and pushing, then reverses into prostration and approach.
The final coordinated imperatives bind lowering to nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed force-images; I infer the directional arrows coercion-to-capture and voluntary lowering-to-nearness. A live alternative treats these as separate threats and commands without a shared kinetic contrast.

changed_reading.before: Prayer displays the servant's low position.
changed_reading.after: Prayer distinguishes chosen lowering, which produces nearness, from forced lowering, which tries to turn the body into a captured object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation and supplicatory prayer establish one address; the later parallel calls gather a council and counter-gather pushing agents. The apparently private prayer becomes the acoustic center of rival summons and rival assemblies.

activation_trace.role: Devotional obedience supplies the lone speaker's relational stance.
Supplication and praise make prayer an address capable of standing against later calls.
Reading and recitation open an acoustic-verbal field before the prayer.
Calling and inclining others through speech launch the prohibitor's counter-summons.
The people's council and assembly give the first counter-summons a social body.
The repeated call answers the first summons in the same acoustic register.
Pushing and prevention characterize the effective force gathered by the answering call.

structural_cues: The near-parallel forms فَلْيَدْعُ and سَنَدْعُ place two summons in direct response.
A singular indefinite servant at prayer is set against named collective bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, prayer-as-supplication, repeated calling, council, and pushing agents; I infer an acoustic and social contest. A live alternative keeps prayer non-vocal and treats the later calls as merely tactical recruitment.

changed_reading.before: The servant's prayer is a private devotional address.
changed_reading.after: The prayer initiates a contest of calls: solitary supplication stands opposite a recruited council and an answering coercive assembly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because enslaving and snare are form-distant branches for عَبْدًا and صَلَّى. It remains anchored because both exact focus roots converge on capture and the context adds restraint, forelock seizure, pushing, and negated obedience. Render it only as a coercion analogy, never as a claim that صَلَّى lexically means trap or that عَبْدًا is an enslaving verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes the عبد inventory's making-a-slave branch with the صلو inventory's set-snare branch.

activation_trace.role: Making someone slave-like supplies attempted subjugation as a process rather than a settled identity.
Snares and traps make the prayer occasion imageable as the site of attempted capture.
Prohibition supplies the first closing movement of the proposed trap.
Forelock seizure turns figurative capture into an explicit bodily threat.
Pushing and prevention supply the enforcement mechanism of capture.
Negated obedience prevents attempted subjugation from becoming accepted servitude.

changed_reading.before: A servant is interrupted while praying.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, coercive power tries to convert the prayer occasion into a snare that manufactures its own servant, while refusal keeps devotion from becoming capture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the two implement branches are remote nominal uses, not plausible direct glosses of the focus forms. It remains valid as a branch-level material convergence: both exact focus roots name paired perfume-working surfaces, and a context branch supplies perfuming. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy of refinement and fragrance, not a lexical interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The عبد and صلو inventories attached to the two focus words independently converge on a perfume mortar and a pounding stone.

activation_trace.role: The named perfume mortar supplies one implement in a preparation process.
The broad pounding stone supplies the matching working surface for perfume.
Perfuming and coating with scent supply the product domain that exposes the focus-root convergence.

changed_reading.before: Prayer simply expresses an already formed servant.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained material analogy, prayer pounds and refines the servant's offered substance until devotion becomes fragrant and spreadable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because haste, the second horse, and bringing a horse near in the run are branch-distant images. It remains anchored through a three-root convergence that turns static posture into prompt following. Render it as a kinetic analogy for prayer's sequencing, not as an equine gloss of any focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots can pair slight haste in عبد with the second-place follower in صلو.

activation_trace.role: Brief delay and modest haste make the servant's response prompt rather than static.
The second horse following at the leader's flank supplies ordered close pursuit.
Bringing a horse near in running gives the final approach the same kinetic domain.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a stationary marker of submission.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prayer is prompt close-following: the servant takes position behind a precedence and advances toward nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the split mapping of the prayer root coactivates mercy and exposure to fire. It remains anchored in the exact focus root, and the later scorching branch gives heat a contextual activator. Render this as a polarity inside the branch field, not as a claim that ritual prayer denotes fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split صلو inventory at 96:10[3] carries both supplication-mercy and encountering-heat branches while the servant remains devotionally anchored.

activation_trace.role: Devotional submission keeps the thermal polarity attached to the praying servant.
Supplication, praise, and mercy supply the beneficent pole of prayer.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the adverse pole latent in the split root.
Scorching fire and hot wind activate the adverse thermal pole in the threat sequence.

changed_reading.before: Prayer belongs only to the semantic field of mercy and worship.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the prayer scene holds a thermal fork: the servant seeks mercy while coercive power answers with scorching exposure.

strongest_changes: Prayer becomes selective allegiance rather than generic submission: obedience to the prohibitor is refused while servitude is enacted toward the Lord.
Creation, attachment, false sufficiency, return, and nearness recast prayer as recurrent reattachment of a dependent creature.
The body can be read as an inscription surface, with ritual posture forming a visible sign between pen-teaching and witnessed prostration.
Voluntary lowering toward nearness is sharply distinct from imposed lowering by restraint, forelock seizure, and pushing.
Supplicatory prayer enters a contest of calls and assemblies rather than remaining a private act.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots opened unusually productive cross-domain fields: عبد held devotion, ownership, imposed subjugation, yielding, haste, and a perfume implement, while the split صلو inventory held ritual, mercy, following, snare, heat, and a pounding surface. Context selected several mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Pronoun allocation across the conditionals of 96:11-13 remains genuinely live and can redistribute guidance, command, denial, and turning between agents.
The inscription and rival-summons models depend on reader-supplied links across adjacent semantic domains, although every branch citation is local and resolvable.
The snare, perfume, race, and thermal readings are deliberately retained as form-distant analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
